messages:
elaine: Quick note 1 1 - ISV partner ForgeLabs wants a self-service sandbox demo of LangChain + LlamaIndex routed through Redwood Gateway + their orchestrator. They want customers to be able to run it end-to-end.

vikram: We should force ephemeral creds only. Plan: OIDC PKCE -> short-lived JWT (2-5m) + rotate demo keys after each session.

otto: Agreed. Also add an audit-export step so partners can pull logs for compliance. Marketplaces ask for exportable artifacts.

elaine: Can we keep the demo out of the public marketplace listing initially? Marketing wants a dev-showcase, not a full marketplace listing.

otto: Yes, keep it labeled "partner dev-showcase" and embargo public assets until partners sign off.

vikram: Infra options: (A) Sandbox Private deployment (fast) or (B) Dedicated reserved pool (more isolation). For a self-service sandbox, Private with strict ingress and a read-only demo role seems best.

ci-bot: note: created branch partnerships/forgelabs-sandbox and added smoke test job 'forgelabs-token-rotation' (status: queued)

elaine: Security: require IP allowlist for partner-run sandbox, webhook HMAC verification, and disable KV prefix caching to keep outputs reproducible. Add a fixed prompt bundle and RNG seed.

otto: I'll draft a 1-page runbook with steps: onboarding, token flow, smoke tests, rollback, and demo teardown.

vikram: I'll provision an ephemeral OIDC client and put credentials in Vault; set a policy that rotates creds nightly for the sandbox org.

legal: Flag: do not publish any HW perf numbers or benchmark charts unless ForgeLabs' hardware partner (if any) signs NDA and benchmark disclosure. We'll need contact + exact metrics requested.

elaine: Timeline: ForgeLabs asked for a customer-facing demo next Thursday. Can we do internal dry run Wed 10am PT?

vikram: Wed 10am PT internal dry run works. I'll provision Private sandbox by Wed 6am PT.

ci-bot: pipeline: forgelabs-token-rotation started (running)

otto: Follow-ups: otto -> runbook PR by EOD Mon; vikram -> vault creds + sandbox ready by Wed 6am PT; elaine -> send NDA + dry run invite and confirm embargo window.

elaine: I'll cc marketing + legal on the invite and propose a 10-day embargo after sign-off. :rocket:
